academicJudgment.claimTested: A meaningful UCR response to the selected philosophy-with-economics disciplinary formation, or a narrower confirmed-core response.
academicJudgment.strongestResponse: Current UCR philosophy of knowledge, ethics, mind, emotion and agency, with actual economics/finance/business and empirical methods, provides a real interdisciplinary response. The two other research trials reorganise philosophy around society/law or health/human existence. Their coherence is not evidence that an unidentified external disciplinary pathway has been reconstructed.

adverseResolutions.resolution: The permitted complementary set emphasises quantitative economics and scientific explanation, with the relevant ESE philosophy package.
adverseResolutions.effect: The best response and its limitations depend on the actual economic methods, philosophical integration and disciplinary thesis. The present broad business mixture cannot certify that emphasis.

adverseResolutions.resolution: Another approved economics/business distribution and a different current philosophical integration apply.
adverseResolutions.effect: The balance of the closest UCR response and its comparison relationships can change. Recognition is partly formal, but the unidentified course distribution and discipline-specific inquiry are substantive.

academicJudgment.coreBoundary: The 60 EC of common taught philosophy are substantial, including advanced common study; this is not rejected by a numerical credit threshold. Yet the defining object of this target is philosophical reflection on a specific scientific discipline. Excluding all complementary study, its discipline-specific philosophy and any dependent thesis interpretation would remove that object from the assessed claim. A comparison of general philosophy alone would be a useful connection but would not establish the required closest response to this target. The confirmed thesis title/credits do not independently establish its substantive disciplinary scope.
academicJudgment.negativeChallenge: A robust no-match is also unsupported: actual UCR philosophical and economic teaching offers plausible meaningful responses once the selected external integration is known. Missing approval paperwork or the external title is no negative proof.
academicJudgment.outcome: Remain external-programme-unresolved. This is a claim-specific target/route and substantive-integration dependency, rather than a demand for administrative perfection.
